comment: Files that cannot reach the per-file threshold, with the reason and the floor they are held to.
An entry here is a deliberate, reviewable decision — it shows up in the diff. It is NOT an
exemption: the file must still stay above its recorded floor, so nothing can quietly regress.
Leave out a floor for a dimension and that dimension keeps the full threshold.

Removed: `intelligence/github/repo-sync.ts` (branches >= 90). Its floor rested on the belief that its tests needed network access. They do not: the integration tests build local git repositories. The belief came from a command wrapped in `timeout`, which macOS does not have, so the tests never ran and the empty output was read as a hang. With them running, the file clears 95 locally.

packages/infra/src/filesystem/watcher.ts.reason: Platform-dependent arms. fs.watch reports an in-place write as 'rename' under FSEvents (macOS) and as 'change' under inotify (Linux), so no single platform can execute both the 'change' branch and the FSEvents-specific rename paths. Measured 85.18% branches on the Linux CI runner and 92.59% locally, with different uncovered lines in each case.
